Implement backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/auth/service/MfaService.java only.
- Import existing models: TotpSecret, TotpSecretRepository, RefreshToken, RefreshTokenRepository, User, UserRepository.
- Implement clean, concise methods:
  * generateTotpSecret(Long userId): generates random 16-character base32 secret string, saves/updates TotpSecret (isEnabled=false), returns secret string.
  * verifyTotpCode(Long userId, String code): verifies 6-digit TOTP code using standard time-step (30s window), sets isEnabled=true on success, returns boolean.
  * rotateRefreshToken(Long userId, String oldTokenHash): marks old token isRevoked=true, creates new RefreshToken entity (UUID random hash, expires in 30 days), returns new token string.
